commits.message:
fix: restore legacy src/data/catalog.json copy so CI provenance check does not fail

The committed deploy-pages.yml still requires ./src/data/catalog.json in its
'Verify catalog provenance' step. That workflow file cannot be updated from
this environment (GitHub rejects pushes touching .github/workflows/* without
OAuth workflow scope). Moving the runtime catalog to public/data/catalog.json
(evidence-contract-v2 work) broke that CI step. build-catalog.js now writes
both locations until the workflow file itself can be fixed.
commits.author: OverKill Hill P³

commits.message:
Skillz Forge: evidence contract v2, deploy integrity fixes, family pages

Section A (P0):
- A1: deploy-pages.yml path filter was missing askjamie, glee-fully,
  knowledge-operations, context-extraction, outcome-modeling (5 of 15
  families never triggered a deploy). Fixed and documented.
- A2: skillz.manifest.json counts are now regenerated from the just-built
  catalog and self-checked at build time.
- A3: catalog.json moved to public/data/ and fetched at runtime via a new
  CatalogProvider/useCatalog() context, not bundled as a static JS import.
  Added predev hook so the dev server has fresh data too.
- A5: focus-visible ring on inputs, ellipsis character fix, mascot image
  width/height to prevent layout shift.
- A6: added a home-page trust statement explaining how evidence is derived.
- A7: tags/topics are now parsed from metadata.tags/topics frontmatter
  instead of being hardcoded to [].

Section B (P1) - evidence-contract v2:
- New SkillEvidence/SkillPackageMetadata/ReleaseReadiness types, kept
  deliberately separate from the existing 7-value evidenceStatus (see
  inline comments in catalog.ts and build-catalog.js).
- build-catalog.js derives evidence.status, counts, blockers, and
  releaseReadiness per skill; enforces rule 7 (live requires
  evaluatedSkillVersion + lastEvidenceDate) and rule 8 (non-Community
  packages need the full Foundry baseline) as build failures.
- Explore: new release-readiness filter, evidence chips, new sort keys
  (updated, evidence-freshness, version).
- SkillDetail: new "Evidence and release state" section.
- FAQ: new release-readiness entry.
- 13 deterministic tests in scripts/test-catalog.mjs, wired into the
  build/deploy workflow.

Section C (P2):
- C1: /families/:family page rendering each FAMILY.md's hand-written
  narrative (previously had no home in the app at all).
- C2: build-time GitHub commit feed (scripts/build-activity.mjs) - fetched
  at build, not from the browser, so the SPA needs no GitHub token.
- C3: tags/topics wired into SkillDetail display.

Deferred: C4 (companion/pathway view) and full C5 (mobile/keyboard sweep)
not implemented this pass; maturitySource's evidence-policy derivation
path also remains unimplemented (documented gap, not silently dropped).
commits.author: OverKill Hill P³

commits.message:
fix(forge): fix .gitignore blind spot that broke every deploy since run #58

forge/src/assets/murderbird-sentinel.png was matched by the blanket *.png
gitignore rule with no exception for forge/src/assets/, so it was never
committed even though Home.tsx imports it. Every checkout in this Replit
workspace already had the file on disk (untracked), so local builds always
succeeded silently. A fresh clone -- including every GitHub Actions run
since deploy #58 -- was missing the file, so 'vite build' failed on an
unresolved import and the Pages deploy job was skipped. Add explicit
gitignore exceptions for forge/src/assets/*.png and *.svg and track the file.
commits.author: OverKill Hill P³
